newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Grafton acquires Wessex Builders Merchants.
newsitem.headline: Grafton acquires Wessex Builders Merchants.

text.p: Grafton Group Plc said on Wednesday that it had acquired the entire share capital of Wessex Builders Merchants Ltd for a cash consideration of up to four million sterling.

Immediately following completion, agreement has been reached to recover an outstanding loan of around 0.54 million which was advanced to a former group company, thereby reducing the consideration to around 3.5 million, Grafton said in a statement.

Wessex, which has a plumbing, heating and sanitary-ware merchants business and a builders merchanting business, made a draft pre-tax profit of 0.6 million sterling on turnover of 14.1 million last year.
"The acquisition of Wessex significantly enhances the scale of the group's activities in the UK builders merchanting sector," Grafton's executive chairman Michael Chadwick said.

Grafton acquired London-based builders merchants, Hendricks Lovell, for 2.7 million sterling last week and has invested 7.5 million in acquisitions of builders and plumbers merchanting businesses in the UK since the start of 1997.
